Title: Verify A01 event is generated with ENCOUNTERCLASS = IMP and all mandatory fields populated
Steps: Insert a valid encounter record with ENCOUNTERCLASS = 'IMP'. Populate all mandatory fields: MSH (fields 1–4, 7, 9, 10, 12), EVN, PID.3 (Health ID), PID.7 (DOB), PV1.2 (Patient Class), PV1.4 (Admission Type), PV1.7 (Attending Doctor), PV1.10 (Hospital Service), PV1.19 (Visit Number), PV1.44 (Admit Date), PV1.45 (Discharge Date). Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: A01 event record is created successfully. HL7 message is generated with all 4 mandatory segments (MSH, EVN, PID, PV1). MSH.9 = 'ADT^A01'. Event is marked ready for submission.

Title: Verify A01 event is generated with ENCOUNTERCLASS = SS and all mandatory fields populated
Steps: Insert a valid encounter record with ENCOUNTERCLASS = 'SS'. Populate all mandatory fields as in TC-P01. Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: A01 event record is created. HL7 message is generated correctly with MSH.9 = 'ADT^A01'. Behaviour is identical to IMP encounter class.

Title: Verify A01 event is generated with all optional segments included (PD1 + PV2 + AL1 + DG1 + PR1)
Steps: Use a fully populated encounter: all mandatory fields plus PD1.3 (Primary Facility), PD1.4 (PCP), PV2.3 (Admit Reason), PV2.8 (Expected Admit DateTime), PV2.9 (Expected Discharge DateTime), one AL1 segment (AL1.2 Allergy Type + AL1.3 Allergen), one DG1 segment (DG1.3 Diagnosis Code), one PR1 segment (PR1.3 Procedure Code + PR1.5 Procedure DateTime). Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: A01 event is generated. HL7 message includes all 9 segments: MSH, EVN, PID, PD1, PV1, PV2, AL1, DG1, PR1. All fields in each segment are correctly populated from the source data.

Title: Verify A01 event is generated with multiple DG1 and PR1 repeats
Steps: Populate 3 diagnosis codes in DG1 and 2 procedure entries in PR1 for the same encounter. Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: A01 HL7 message contains 3 DG1 segments and 2 PR1 segments. Each segment carries the correct corresponding code. No diagnosis or procedure is dropped or duplicated.

Title: Verify PV1.7 (Attending Doctor) accepts multiple repeats
Steps: Populate 3 attending doctor entries with valid National/Iqama Provider IDs and Assigning Authority = '2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.2.1'. Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: All 3 attending doctor repeats are included in PV1.7 of the generated HL7 message. Assigning Authority is correctly set on each repeat.

Title: Verify MSH.7 (Date/Time of Message) is generated in correct format with timezone offset
Steps: Trigger an A01 event and inspect MSH.7 in the generated HL7 message.
Expected Result: MSH.7 is populated in the format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS+/-ZZZZ. Timezone offset is present and non-empty. Field length does not exceed 26 characters.

Title: Verify PV1.19 (Visit Number) uniquely identifies the encounter
Steps: Submit two A01 events for two different patients, each with a distinct PV1.19 value. Inspect both generated messages.
Expected Result: Each HL7 message contains a unique PV1.19 value. The two visit numbers are different. Visit Number correctly corresponds to each patient's encounter.

Title: Verify EVN.2 (Recorded DateTime) is used as event timestamp when provided
Steps: Populate EVN.2 with a specific datetime (e.g. 20260101120000) and trigger the event. Inspect EVN.2 in the generated HL7 message.
Expected Result: EVN.2 in the HL7 message matches the value provided. MSH.7 is used as fallback only when EVN.2 is empty.

Title: Verify PD1.4 (Primary Care Provider) is stored using first repeat only when multiple are supplied
Steps: Populate 3 repeats in PD1.4, each with a valid National Provider ID and Assigning Authority = '2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.2.1'. Trigger event generation and inspect the stored PD1.4.
Expected Result: Only the first repeat of PD1.4 is stored, as per the NPHIES specification. Subsequent repeats are not stored. No error is raised.

Title: Verify AL1.3 with free text (no coded identifier) is accepted when Allergy Type is present
Steps: Set AL1.3 with only the Text field populated (no Identifier or Name of Coding System). Set AL1.2 with a valid Allergy Type code. Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: AL1 segment is accepted. AL1.3 Text field is stored. The system does not reject the record for missing AL1.3 Identifier when only free text is available.

Expected Result: Event generation is blocked. Validation error: 'PID.3 (Patient Identifier / Health ID) is required and must be the first repeat.' No HL7 message is produced.

Title: Verify AL1.2 (Allergy Type) is required when an AL1 segment is present

Expected Result: Event generation is blocked or the AL1 segment is rejected. Validation error: 'AL1.2 (Allergy Type) is required when AL1 segment is present.' No incomplete AL1 is stored.

Title: Verify A01 event is not generated when ENCOUNTERCLASS = AMB
Steps: Insert an encounter record with ENCOUNTERCLASS = 'AMB'. Trigger event detection.
Expected Result: No A01 event is generated. Record is not classified as an inpatient admission. System may route this to A04 detection or log it as a non-A01 encounter.

Title: Verify A01 event is not generated when ENCOUNTERCLASS is NULL
Steps: Insert an encounter record with ENCOUNTERCLASS = NULL. Trigger event detection.
Expected Result: No A01 event is generated. Error is logged: 'ENCOUNTERCLASS is mandatory'. Record is skipped.

Title: Verify A01 event is blocked when PID.3 Assigning Authority is not the required OID
Steps: Populate PID.3 with a Health ID but set Assigning Authority to an incorrect OID (e.g. '1.2.3.4.5'). Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: Event generation is blocked. Validation error states Assigning Authority for PID.3 must be '2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.1.100.1'. No HL7 message is produced.

Title: Verify A01 event is blocked when PV1.44 Admit DateTime is in the future
Steps: Set PV1.44 to a date 30 days in the future. Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: Event generation is blocked. Validation error states Admit Date/Time cannot be a future date.

Title: Verify A01 event is blocked when PV1.45 Discharge DateTime is before PV1.44 Admit DateTime
Steps: Set PV1.44 = 20260510120000 and PV1.45 = 20260501090000 (discharge before admission). Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: Event generation is blocked. Validation error: 'Discharge Date/Time cannot be before Admit Date/Time.'

Title: Verify A01 event is blocked when PV1.14 (Admit Source) contains an unrecognised code value
Steps: Set PV1.14 to a code not in the 'Admit Source' value set (e.g. 'ZZZ'). Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: Event generation is blocked. Error CDR000 is returned. Validation message: 'Couldn't find CodeDefinition for CodeIdentifier' referencing PV1.14.

Title: Verify A01 event is blocked when DG1.15 (Diagnosis Priority) contains a non-numeric value
Steps: Set DG1.15 to 'HIGH' (non-numeric). Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: Event generation is blocked. Validation error: 'DG1.15 (Diagnosis Priority) must be numeric.' Non-numeric values are rejected.

Title: Verify A01 event is blocked when MSH.4 (Sending Facility) exceeds 50 characters
Steps: Set MSH.4 to a 51-character string. Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: Event generation is blocked. Validation error states MSH.4 cannot exceed 50 characters.

Title: Verify a duplicate A01 event is not generated when the same PV1.19 (Visit Number) is submitted again
Steps: Submit a valid A01 event with PV1.19 = 'VISIT-001'. Confirm event is created. Submit the same event again with the same PV1.19.
Expected Result: The second submission is rejected. No duplicate A01 event is created. System returns an error or logs that PV1.19 'VISIT-001' already exists.

Expected Result: Event generation is blocked. Validation error references the incorrect Assigning Authority on PV1.7.

Steps: Set PID.3 = NULL. Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: Event generation is blocked. Error: 'PID.3 is required and cannot be NULL.' No HL7 message is produced.

Steps: Set PID.3 = '' (empty string). Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: Event generation is blocked. Error: 'PID.3 cannot be empty.' Treated the same as NULL.

Steps: Set EVN.2 = NULL. Populate MSH.7 with a valid datetime. Trigger event generation. Inspect EVN.2 in the generated HL7 message.

Expected Result: A01 event is generated. Same-day admit and discharge is accepted as a valid inpatient encounter. No validation error.

Expected Result: A01 event is generated. DG1.15 = '1' is stored correctly. Numeric value is accepted without error.

Expected Result: A01 event is generated. AL1.6 = '20250901' is stored correctly. Format matches the specification.

Title: Verify PV2.12 (Visit Description) is accepted up to its 400-character limit

Expected Result: A01 event is generated. PV2.12 is stored with all 400 characters intact. No truncation.

Expected Result: A01 event is generated. PR1.5 is stored with the full datetime and timezone offset. No transformation or truncation.

Title: Verify A01 event correctly handles PID.7 (DOB) for a newborn (today's date)
Steps: Set PID.7 to today's date in YYYYMMDD format. Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: A01 event is generated. PID.7 is accepted as today's date. Date of birth equal to current date is valid for a newborn admission.

Title: Verify A01 event is generated correctly when PV2.8 and PV2.9 (Expected Admit/Discharge) are provided but differ from PV1.44/PV1.45 (Actual Admit/Discharge)
Steps: Populate PV2.8 with an expected admit date 1 day before PV1.44, and PV2.9 with an expected discharge date different from PV1.45. Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: A01 event is generated. PV1.44 and PV1.45 hold the actual dates. PV2.8 and PV2.9 hold the expected dates independently. No conflict error is raised. Both sets of dates are stored correctly.

Expected Result: A01 event is generated. AL1.2 = 'DALG' and AL1.3 uses the correct drug allergy code set. No value set mismatch error.

Expected Result: A01 event is generated. AL1.2 = 'FALG' and AL1.3 uses the correct food allergy code set. No value set mismatch error.

Title: Verify A01 message is valid when MSH.5 (Receiving Application) is omitted (optional field)
Steps: Leave MSH.5 empty. Populate all mandatory fields. Trigger event generation.
Expected Result: A01 event is generated without error. MSH.5 is optional and its absence does not block the event. All mandatory MSH fields are still present.
